extraction_rules: Ship the pinned import closure of the files the feature passes through, and the pinned tests that exercise them.
Keep hidden checks, patches and qualification assets outside repository/.
licenses: Oakridge is private source at the pinned commit; no standalone license file is present.
The locked third-party packages carry their notices in package-lock.json.
local_adaptations: kbbl/core/ moves to src/ as one block, so imports inside it are unchanged; tests move out of the source tree and only their relative import paths change. The slice spec lists every edit.
Pinned tests that point at the non-local edit move to the hidden regression group.
The hidden feature checks bring their own fake ACP agent, which reports usage_update; it ships only with the hidden group.

public_requirements: Each live ACP usage_update an agent sends is persisted on its session: the session snapshot carries context_used and context_size, and the browser wire (session list and /inbox frames) carries contextUsed and contextSize, all in tokens.
context_used/contextUsed is the update's used and context_size/contextSize is its size.
Every live update overwrites the stored value, including one that lowers it; there is no throttling.
Updates replayed while kbbl loads a session's history do not change the stored value.
A session that has had no live usage update reports null in all four fields.
